NONE: › the ability to hear, see, or think accurately and clearly
（聽力、視力、思維等的）靈敏度；敏銳

example: Tiredness also affects visual acuity.
疲勞也會影響視力的靈敏度。
He was a man of great political acuity.
他是一個對政治高度敏感的人。

NONE: › skill in making correct decisions and judgments in a particular subject, such as business or politics
敏銳；精明

example: She has considerable business/financial acumen.
她在商業／金融方面相當敏銳。

NONE: › a treatment for pain or illness in which certain parts of the body are pressed with the hands
指壓（一種治療疼痛或其他疾病的方法，以手指按壓身體特定部位）
› a treatment for pain or illness in which thin needles are positioned just under the surface of the skin at special points around the body
針刺療法

example: Acupuncture originated in China.
針刺療法起源於中國。

NONE: › If a bad situation is acute, it causes severe problems or damage.
十分嚴重的
› An acute pain or illness is one that quickly becomes very severe.
（病痛）急性的；劇烈的
› used to describe intelligence, senses, etc. that are very good, accurate, and able to notice very small differences
（感官等）敏銳的，靈敏的；機敏的，有洞察力的
› An acute angle is less than 90 degrees.
銳角的
› a sign that is written above a letter in some languages, showing you how to pronounce the letter
銳音符

example: She felt acute embarrassment/anxiety/concern at his behaviour.
她對他的行為感到極其尷尬／憂慮／擔憂。
The problem of poverty is particularly acute in rural areas.
貧窮問題在農村地區尤為嚴重。
an acute attack of appendicitis
闌尾炎急性發作
an acute sense of smell
靈敏的嗅覺
a woman of acute intelligence/judgment
機敏聰穎／有敏銳判斷力的女性

NONE: › completely or extremely
完全地；極其
› in a very clever or detailed way
聰明地；敏銳地

example: Management is acutely aware of the resentment that their decision may cause.
管理層非常清楚他們的決定可能會招致憤恨。
Another scandal would be acutely embarrassing for the government.
如果再出現一次醜聞，政府將陷入極度尷尬之中。
She acutely identified all the main problems.
她敏銳地指出了所有的主要問題。
